label: Update research track
description: Requested sections only. Read first; preserve findings/citations/manual edits/IDs. Reconcile conflicts or uncertain outcomes before retrying. History retains prior content.

parameter_descriptions.track_id: ID or null for attached track.
parameter_descriptions.section: Main section or exploration/filename (no .md). Filenames: lowercase letters/digits, hyphens/underscores, max 80.
parameter_descriptions.content: Full preserved Markdown. States: Suggested, Planned, Running, Completed, Blocked, Cancelled.
parameter_descriptions.expected_sha256: Latest document read hash; null only to create a new exploration file, never overwrite.
